examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{方法|ほうほう}を用いる。

notes:
{用|もち}いる is a formal verb meaning to use or employ, primarily used in written language.

TRANSITIVITY:
Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

REGISTER:
- {用|もち}いる: formal, written style
- {使|つか}う: neutral, everyday use

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {方法|ほうほう}を{用|もち}いる: to use a method
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}を{用|もち}いる: to employ technology
- 〜に{用|もち}いられる: to be used in ~
